scholarships.title: Singapore University of Social Sciences Scholarship (Part-time Undergraduate)

existing.description: The Singapore University of Social Sciences Scholarship is SUSS's premier institutional scholarship for part-time undergraduates, covering 100% of the course fee inclusive of government subsidy for the recipient's remaining candidature, together with course materials, examination fees, other compulsory fees and Miscellaneous Fees. No bond is attached. It is open to Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents with outstanding academic results, strong language skills, a strong co-curricular record and demonstrated leadership and community service, and is not available for Law programmes. Applications run 1 August to 15 September for the January Semester and 1 February to 15 March for the July Semester.
eligibility: Impressive track record in co-curricular activities
Demonstrated leadership qualities and zest for involvement in community service
Outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE A Level, local polytechnic diploma, International Baccalaureate diploma, NUS High School diploma or equivalent qualifications
New students must already have been accepted for admission before being considered for the scholarship
Not available for students applying to the Law programmes
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents who are pursuing a SUSS part-time undergraduate programme, with outstanding academic results, strong language skills, an impressive co-curricular track record, demonstrated leadership and community service involvement. New students must first be accepted for admission before being considered. Outstanding GCE A Level, local polytechnic diploma, International Baccalaureate diploma, NUS High School diploma or equivalent qualifications are expected. Not available for Law programmes.
benefits: 100% of course fee (inclusive of government subsidy) for the recipient's remaining candidature of study
Course materials, examination fee, other compulsory fees and Miscellaneous Fees included
No bond attached to the scholarship
coverage: 100% of course fee inclusive of government subsidy for the recipient's remaining candidature
Examination fee and other compulsory fees
documents: Completed online scholarship application submitted by the closing date
Admission e-application submitted first for new students
application_method: Submit an admission e-application first (new students must be accepted for admission before being considered for the scholarship)
Submit the scholarship application online by the stipulated closing date using the SUSS e-guide
Await the outcome notification by email
existing.selection_notes: Candidates will be notified of the application outcome via email by end November for the January Semester and by end June for the July Semester. The decision of the Student Awards Committee of SUSS is final and binding, no reason will be given for non-selection, and no appeal will be entertained. Previously unsuccessful candidates need not re-apply.
existing.best_fit: Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident working adults with strong prior academic results and a substantial community and co-curricular record entering a SUSS part-time degree programme.
existing.notes: The same SUSS page also lists donor-funded awards for part-time undergraduates (Kewalram Chanrai Group Scholarship up to S$10,000, Hong Leong Foundation Scholarship, ST Engineering - SUSS Scholarship, UOB Future Resilience Scholarship) and SUSS-funded sponsorships with the SUSS-NTUC, SUSS-SAFRA, SUSS-HomeTeamNS, SUSS-OTCi, SUSS-STU, SUSS-PA and SUSS-STTA Sports Leader. These are separate awards.
existing.duration: The minimum period required to complete the full programme of study, as stipulated by the programme
existing.application_period: Two intakes a year: 1 August to 15 September for the January Semester and 1 February to 15 March for the July Semester. Outcomes are notified by email by end November (January Semester) and end June (July Semester).
existing.deadline_display: SUSS publishes two annual scholarship application periods: 'Scholarship application period: January Semester: 1 August to 15 September; July Semester: 1 February to 15 March'. The January Semester window closed on 15 September 2026, so the next window is the July Semester intake, 1 February to 15 March.
existing.program_type: Institutional merit scholarship for part-time undergraduate study
